## On the Issues
Preventing Gun Violence
Standing Up for Israel
Fighting for Affordability
Protecting the Environment
## Defending Democracy
Donald Trump and extremist Republicans have been on a mission to disenfranchise voters, weaken democratic institutions, undermine the rule of law and sow unfounded doubts about the legitimacy of our electoral system and processes. Jared will fight back, ensuring that American democracy is insulated from Trumpism and placed on a safer path than the one which ultimately led us to the horrific events of January 6th, 2021. He will support election security at the national level, advocate for reforms to stop gerrymandering and ensure minority representation, make Election Day a national holiday, universalize vote by mail, and standardize the process by which elections are certified in order to blunt GOP attempts to invalidate them.
## Preventing Gun Violence
When 17 people died in the mass shooting at Jared’s alma mater, Marjory Stoneman Douglas High School in Parkland, he championed the movement to pass meaningful reforms through the Florida Legislature in order to make sure a tragedy like this could never happen again in the Sunshine State. As a State Representative, he worked with the families of the victims and lawmakers from both sides of the political divide to enact historic gun violence prevention legislation raising the age to buy guns from 18 to 21 and putting in place “red flag laws” giving law enforcement the power to take away firearms from those too dangerous to responsibly possess them. In Congress, Jared will fight to make this law a model for the nation and to ban assault weapons.
## Safeguarding Reproductive Rights
As a State Legislator, Jared fought against attempts to restrict abortion rights. When the draft decision overturning Roe v. Wade was leaked, he immediately called on the U.S. Senate to bypass the filibuster and codify Roe into law. In Congress, he will be committed to making sure reproductive rights are protected by the federal government and that we continue the fight for health care equity.
## Standing up for the LGBTQ+ Community
Love is love. As hate crimes against the LGBTQ+ community continue to rise, Jared is focused on fighting against bigotry and stigmas. In Congress, Jared will be a strong ally to the LGBTQ+ community, advocating for anti-discrimination policies and safeguarding marriage equality, just as he did in the FL legislature. He will also continue sponsorship of Congressman Deutch’s Ruthie and Connie LGBT Elder Americans Act.
## Protecting Social Security, Medicare, and Obamacare
The GOP is working overtime in Washington to gut three of the most popular government initiatives on which Americans rely: Social Security, Medicare and the Affordable Care Act – but Jared won’t let them. In Congress, he’ll fight to expand Medicare, protect Social Security, and reduce prescription drug costs. He will also work to protect and expand the Affordable Care Act, which has extended coverage to millions in our country – including those with preexisting conditions who previously had no access to the care they needed.
## Standing Up For Israel
Jared’s great-grandparents were killed at Auschwitz, and his grandparents barely escaped Europe before the war. Today, antisemitism is on the rise globally and the U.S.-Israel relationship is more important than ever. Jared is 100% committed to continuing U.S. military assistance to Israel; keeping the U.S. embassy in Jerusalem; and strengthening economic, diplomatic and military ties with Israel. He is a staunch fighter against the BDS movement and will work to stop antisemitism in all its forms.
## Fighting for Affordability
South Florida has become one of the country’s least affordable communities. In Congress, Jared is committed to taking concrete actions to reduce the cost of living when it comes to housing, property insurance, inflation, gasoline, groceries, and other basic household goods. That’s why on the Broward County Commission, Jared recently advocated for over 1,000 new affordable housing units. In Congress, he’ll fight for lower gas prices, more federal funds for workforce housing, and renter protection initiatives to crack down on bad actors.
## Economic Stability and Opportunities
Inflation is just one barrier to families’ economic success. Congress should work to create new opportunities to financially empower and include all Americans. Jared will advocate for financial innovations and new technologies that advance economic justice, provide increased accessibility to new tools and opportunities, and make financial policies more inclusive. In short, he is dedicated to providing greater access to opportunity. Jared will propel these ideas by supporting innovative legislative measures such as the Responsible Financial Innovation Act (RFIA), while also ensuring that Congress appropriately promotes competition for emerging and novel technologies. A more secure and competitive digital marketplace that incorporates cryptocurrencies and blockchain technologies will secure America’s economy for the next generation. Jared will work to create new economic opportunities, expand entrepreneurship programs, and invest in local economies to create jobs.
## Protecting the Environment
We’re living through a climate crisis that threatens our way of life, and we must act quickly to mitigate the effects of climate change. Investing in environmental protection isn’t just a long-term plan towards clean air, clean water, and sustainability, it’s also a way to reinvigorate the economy and create jobs in our community. Jared was a consistent advocate for environmental causes as a State Representative, and he will fight for bold policies to reduce greenhouse gas emissions, convert to clean energy sources, protect the Everglades, and make our community more resilient against environmental threats.
## Preventing the Next Pandemic
When COVID-19 first emerged, we all saw how unprepared the United States was for a health crisis of its magnitude. As Florida’s Director of Emergency Management, Jared worked hard to respond to the unprecedented challenges Florida faced by accelerating the statewide vaccine distribution network to ensure families across the state were protected. He brought vaccines to senior living facilities, 250+ Black and Hispanic churches, HUD housing, immigrant communities, Holocaust Survivors, and other vulnerable communities. In Congress, Jared will prioritize critical vaccine research, biosecurity for gene synthesis, proper safety protocols around research of concern, supply chain issues, PPE production, and pandemic-proof infrastructure as ways to mitigate COVID-19 and prevent the next pandemic. This also means increasing common sense safety and security measures, like better regulation of gain of function research. Our public health professionals, scientists, and researchers are ready to advance this science and technology, and we need to empower them by fully funding pandemic prevention and preparedness research at the federal level.
Jared Moskowitz for Congress
PO Box 8784
Coral Springs, FL 33065

pages.text:
## Grayscale
## Reading Guide
On the Issues
## Focused on South Florida Families
In Congress, Jared has been unafraid to take on both parties. He'll work with Republicans when it helps Floridians and stand up to both parties, even Democrats, when they're wrong. His job is to answer to South Florida, not to any party.
Lowering the Cost of Living
Skyrocketing property insurance. Gas over $4 a gallon. Prescription drug costs through the roof. Working families and seniors across South Florida are doing everything right and still feel like they can't get ahead, and Washington wastes their tax dollars every day. Jared authored legislation to cut homeowners' property insurance premiums, one of the biggest costs squeezing Florida families, and he has fought to bring down prescription drug prices, expand affordable housing, and crack down on the price gouging that quietly drains family budgets, putting money back in people's pockets. He's also fighting to restore the expanded Child Tax Credit that cut child poverty nearly in half before Washington let it expire, and to bring down the cost of childcare. No family should pay more for daycare than they do for their mortgage.
Protecting Social Security and Medicare
Seniors who have worked hard their entire life are getting squeezed. Republicans have threatened to cut Social Security and Medicare and have undermined support services for those programs. Jared is fighting back against every effort to weaken or privatize these programs, and he's working to strengthen Medicare and bring down the cost of prescription drugs. When Republicans rammed through their "Big Beautiful Bill" slashing nearly a trillion dollars from Medicaid, Jared fought against the bill. Now he's working to reverse those cuts before seniors, people with disabilities, and working families lose their coverage.
Lowering Healthcare Costs
Republicans have let premiums almost double for millions of Americans, including thousands right here in South Florida. Jared is fighting to defend and strengthen the Affordable Care Act, because no one should have to choose between seeing a doctor and paying their bills. Jared is fighting to restore the enhanced ACA tax credits Republicans let expire, so the tens of thousands of South Floridians who buy their own coverage aren't priced out of it. In the long-term, Jared believes healthcare is a right, and he supports moving toward a Medicare for All system that guarantees coverage to every American, because nobody's health should depend on their paycheck.
Keeping Our Schools and Communities Safe
When 17 people were killed at Jared's alma mater, Marjory Stoneman Douglas High School, he turned grief into action, working with Parkland families and lawmakers from both sides of the aisle to pass Florida's red flag protections and raise the age to buy a firearm to 21. In Congress, he has carried that fight forward as a Vice Chair of the Gun Violence Prevention Task Force and a sponsor of bipartisan bills like the MSD Act to strengthen emergency response and keep our schools safe. For Jared, this is personal, and he'll never stop working to keep every student and family safe.
Confronting Antisemitism and Standing with Israel
Antisemitism is rising at an alarming rate, and Jared knows the threat firsthand. He has called out antisemitism from Democrats and Republicans alike and staunchly defended Israel. As a Jewish member of Congress whose great-grandparents were killed at Auschwitz, and grandparents who barely escaped Europe, Jared understands why the U.S.-Israel relationship is critical, and why it must be defended. As a member of the House Foreign Affairs Committee, he has been a steadfast voice for America's support for Israel, backing continued security assistance, keeping the U.S. embassy in Jerusalem, and supporting the expansion of the Abraham Accords to strengthen peace in the region.
Rooting Out Corruption
In Congress, Jared has been unafraid to take on both parties. He supports banning members of Congress from trading stocks, because lawmakers shouldn't profit off information the public doesn't have. He has fought to release the Epstein files, because victims deserve justice and the government should never bury the truth to protect powerful people in either party. And while Washington works overtime to protect its own, Jared is fighting to strengthen the watchdogs, investigators, and oversight to ensure that our elected leaders are always working in the interest of those they represent.
Securing the Border and Fixing a Broken System
Our immigration system is broken, and Floridians want both a secure border and a system that actually works. Jared supports strong border security, and he broke with members of his own party who wanted to defund the agencies that keep our communities safe, but he also believes enforcement has to be accountable and humane, not cruelty for its own sake. He'll work with anyone to secure the border, fix a system that has failed for decades, improve pathways to citizenship, and treat people with basic decency.
Protecting Reproductive Freedom
Decisions about a woman's health belong to her and her doctor, not to politicians in Tallahassee or Washington. Jared opposes Florida's extreme abortion ban and will defend the right to reproductive freedom and access to care against every effort to strip it away.
Disaster Preparedness and Protecting Our Coast
No one in Congress has done this work like Jared. As the former Director of Florida's Division of Emergency Management, a role he was appointed to by a Republican governor, he led the state's response to hurricane after hurricane, because hurricanes don't hit Democrats or Republicans, they hit Floridians. He has carried that hands-on experience to Congress, working across the aisle to reform FEMA and make disaster response faster and more accountable, all while protecting our coastlines, the Everglades, and the paradise we call home from rising seas and stronger storms.
Jared has used his seat on the Judiciary Committee to demand accountability and shine a light on corruption and abuse in both parties. Protecting free and fair elections and the freedom to vote is the work that makes every other priority possible, and Jared will never stop defending it.

pages.text:
## Grayscale
## Reading Guide
In the News
## Jared Moskowitz named Ranking Democrat on House Middle East Subcommittee
August 25, 2026
U.S. Rep. Jared Moskowitz now serves as the top Democrat on the House subcommittee tackling foreign policy in the Middle East.
U.S. Rep. Gregory Meeks of New York, the top Democrat on the full House Foreign Affairs Committee, just announced key assignments on the minority side. That included naming Moskowitz as Ranking Member of the House Foreign Affairs Subcommittee on the Middle East and North Africa, where he immediately succeeds U.S. Rep. Brad Sherman, a California Democrat.
“I also congratulate Representative Moskowitz on his new role as Ranking Member of the Middle East and North Africa Subcommittee, and thank Rep. Sherman for his stewardship of the Subcommittee,” Meeks said.
Moskowitz welcomed the development, which could pave the way to him chairing the same subcommittee if Democrats secure a majority in the Midterms.
“At a moment of enormous change and instability across the region, America needs a clear and serious strategy,” Moskowitz said. “I am honored to take on this responsibility and ready to get to work.”

Sobre los Temas
## Enfocado en las Familias del Sur de la Florida
En el Congreso, Jared no ha temido enfrentarse a ambos partidos. Trabajará con los republicanos cuando ayude a los floridanos y hará frente a ambos partidos, incluso a los demócratas, cuando se equivoquen. Su trabajo es responder al sur de la Florida, no a ningún partido.
Reducir el Costo de Vida
Primas de seguro de vivienda por las nubes. Gasolina a más de $4 el galón. Costos de medicamentos recetados disparados. Las familias trabajadoras y los adultos mayores de todo el sur de la Florida hacen todo bien y aun así sienten que no pueden salir adelante, mientras Washington desperdicia sus impuestos todos los días. Jared fue autor de una legislación para reducir las primas del seguro de vivienda, uno de los mayores costos que agobian a las familias de la Florida, y ha luchado por bajar el precio de los medicamentos, ampliar la vivienda asequible y frenar el abuso de precios que drena silenciosamente los presupuestos familiares, devolviendo dinero al bolsillo de la gente. También lucha por restaurar el Crédito Tributario por Hijos ampliado, que redujo la pobreza infantil casi a la mitad antes de que Washington lo dejara expirar, y por bajar el costo del cuidado infantil. Ninguna familia debería pagar más por la guardería que por su hipoteca.
Proteger el Seguro Social y Medicare
Los adultos mayores que han trabajado duro toda su vida están siendo exprimidos. Los republicanos han amenazado con recortar el Seguro Social y Medicare, y han debilitado los servicios de apoyo de esos programas. Jared está luchando contra todo intento de debilitar o privatizar estos programas, y trabaja para fortalecer Medicare y reducir el costo de los medicamentos recetados. Cuando los republicanos impulsaron a la fuerza su "Big Beautiful Bill", recortando casi un billón de dólares de Medicaid, Jared se opuso al proyecto de ley. Ahora trabaja para revertir esos recortes antes de que los adultos mayores, las personas con discapacidad y las familias trabajadoras pierdan su cobertura.
Reducir los Costos de la Atención Médica
Los republicanos han permitido que las primas casi se dupliquen para millones de estadounidenses, incluidos miles aquí en el sur de la Florida. Jared lucha por defender y fortalecer la Ley de Cuidado de Salud Asequible, porque nadie debería tener que elegir entre ver a un médico y pagar sus cuentas. Jared lucha por restaurar los créditos fiscales ampliados del ACA que los republicanos dejaron expirar, para que las decenas de miles de floridanos del sur que compran su propia cobertura no queden fuera de su alcance. A largo plazo, Jared cree que la atención médica es un derecho, y apoya avanzar hacia un sistema de Medicare para Todos que garantice cobertura a cada estadounidense, porque la salud de nadie debería depender de su sueldo.
Mantener Seguras Nuestras Escuelas y Comunidades
Cuando 17 personas fueron asesinadas en la antigua preparatoria de Jared, Marjory Stoneman Douglas, él convirtió el dolor en acción, trabajando con las familias de Parkland y legisladores de ambos partidos para aprobar las protecciones de "bandera roja" de la Florida y elevar a 21 años la edad para comprar un arma de fuego. En el Congreso, ha continuado esa lucha como vicepresidente del Grupo de Trabajo para la Prevención de la Violencia con Armas y como patrocinador de proyectos de ley bipartidistas como la Ley MSD para fortalecer la respuesta ante emergencias y mantener seguras nuestras escuelas. Para Jared, esto es personal, y nunca dejará de trabajar para mantener seguros a cada estudiante y cada familia.
Enfrentar el Antisemitismo y Apoyar a Israel
El antisemitismo está aumentando a un ritmo alarmante, y Jared conoce la amenaza de primera mano. Ha denunciado el antisemitismo tanto de demócratas como de republicanos y ha defendido firmemente a Israel. Como miembro judío del Congreso, cuyos bisabuelos fueron asesinados en Auschwitz y cuyos abuelos apenas escaparon de Europa, Jared comprende por qué la relación entre EE. UU. e Israel es fundamental y por qué debe defenderse. Como miembro del Comité de Asuntos Exteriores de la Cámara, ha sido una voz firme en apoyo de Israel, respaldando la asistencia continua en seguridad, manteniendo la embajada de EE. UU. en Jerusalén y apoyando la expansión de los Acuerdos de Abraham para fortalecer la paz en la región.
Erradicar la Corrupción
En el Congreso, Jared no ha temido enfrentarse a ambos partidos. Apoya prohibir que los miembros del Congreso negocien acciones, porque los legisladores no deberían lucrar con información que el público no tiene. Ha luchado por publicar los archivos de Epstein, porque las víctimas merecen justicia y el gobierno nunca debería enterrar la verdad para proteger a personas poderosas de ningún partido. Y mientras Washington trabaja horas extra para protegerse a sí mismo, Jared lucha por fortalecer a los organismos de control, investigadores y la supervisión para asegurar que nuestros líderes electos siempre trabajen en interés de quienes representan.
Asegurar la Frontera y Arreglar un Sistema Roto
Nuestro sistema de inmigración está roto, y los floridanos quieren a la vez una frontera segura y un sistema que realmente funcione. Jared apoya una fuerte seguridad fronteriza, y rompió con miembros de su propio partido que querían desfinanciar a las agencias que mantienen seguras a nuestras comunidades, pero también cree que la aplicación de la ley debe ser responsable y humana, no crueldad por sí misma. Trabajará con cualquiera para asegurar la frontera, arreglar un sistema que ha fallado durante décadas, mejorar las vías hacia la ciudadanía y tratar a las personas con dignidad básica.
Proteger la Libertad Reproductiva
Las decisiones sobre la salud de una mujer le corresponden a ella y a su médico, no a los políticos en Tallahassee o Washington. Jared se opone a la prohibición extrema del aborto en la Florida y defenderá el derecho a la libertad reproductiva y al acceso a la atención frente a todo intento de arrebatarlo.
Preparación ante Desastres y Protección de Nuestra Costa
Nadie en el Congreso ha hecho este trabajo como Jared. Como exdirector de la División de Manejo de Emergencias de la Florida —un cargo al que fue nombrado por un gobernador republicano— dirigió la respuesta del estado ante huracán tras huracán, porque los huracanes no golpean a demócratas ni a republicanos, golpean a los floridanos. Ha llevado esa experiencia práctica al Congreso, trabajando de manera bipartidista para reformar FEMA y hacer que la respuesta ante desastres sea más rápida y responsable, todo mientras protege nuestras costas, los Everglades y el paraíso que llamamos hogar frente al aumento del nivel del mar y tormentas más fuertes.
Defender la Democracia
Jared ha usado su puesto en el Comité Judicial para exigir rendición de cuentas y sacar a la luz la corrupción y el abuso en ambos partidos. Proteger elecciones libres y justas y la libertad de votar es el trabajo que hace posible todas las demás prioridades, y Jared nunca dejará de defenderlo.
